purpose: Evaluate OpenManus as a replaceable bounded execution worker for Kotodama, isolated in a Proxmox KVM guest without direct authority over Current Truth or the Proxmox management plane.

upstream.browser_runtime: Browser Use CLI 3.0 MCP; pin the resolved browser-use package before protected deployment

prohibited_operations: direct Proxmox management API access from the worker
direct mutation of Kotodama Capability Grants
unscoped read of company-wide shared filesystems
production deletion or destructive infrastructure mutation without a separately bound Work Order
payment, contract, or legal commitment outside an explicit bounded grant
promotion_gates: independent verification of artifacts and evidence
negative test for Proxmox management-plane reachability
negative test for non-task shared-data reachability
restart and rollback receipt for the worker guest
dependency and upstream revision pin review
